nights.title: KATSEYE: THE WILDWORLD TOUR
nights.name: Katseye
nights.extract: Katseye is a girl group formed in 2024, based in Los Angeles. The group consists of six members: Daniela Avanzini, Lara Raj, Manon Bannerman, Megan Skiendiel, Sophia Laforteza, and Yoonchae Jeung. With members from the Philippines, South Korea, Switzerland, and the United States, Katseye is often called a "global girl group".
